# observe_maintenance_window (Resource)

A maintenance window: alerts pause for the monitors it covers. Windows cannot be edited, so any change replaces it; destroying it cancels it. A finished window stays in state. A repeating window keeps the first occurrence's `starts_at` and `ends_at` in state while Observe moves it on to the next one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_maintenance_window" "db_upgrade" {
  title       = "Database upgrade"
  description = "Checkout is read-only."
  starts_at   = "2027-01-10T22:00:00Z"
  ends_at     = "2027-01-10T23:00:00Z"
  monitor_ids = [observe_monitor.shop.id]
}

resource "observe_maintenance_window" "weekly_deploys" {
  title      = "Weekly deploy"
  starts_at  = "2027-01-05T06:00:00Z"
  ends_at    = "2027-01-05T06:30:00Z"
  tags       = ["shop"]
  recurrence = "weekly"
  timezone   = "Europe/London"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String)
- `starts_at` (String)
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) Specific monitors; omit monitor_ids, team_id and tags for every monitor
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `recurrence` (String) One of `weekly`, `monthly`.
- `tags` (List of String) Monitors with any of these tags
- `team_id` (String)
- `timezone` (String) Keeps a repeating window's local time across DST

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID
- `status` (String) scheduled, active, completed or cancelled

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_maintenance_window.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
